store.tagline: Sums, units, currencies, dates and time zones as you type
features: Arithmetic with precedence, percentages, powers, factorials and bases: `2^10`, `15% of 240`, `255 to hex`
Units through mathjs plus the spellings people type: `5 km to miles`, `72 f to c`, `12 gb to mb`, `5 ft 3 in to cm`
The 30 ECB currencies by code, symbol or name (`12 usd to try`, `€12 to $`, `1k usd`), rates fetched once a day and cached
Dates and durations: `today + 3 days`, `days until 2026-12-25`, `weeks between 2025-06-15 and 2026-01-01`
Time zones by city, abbreviation or offset: `10:00 utc to tokyo`, `5pm ldn in sf`, `now in utc`
A second row with the other form: the reverse conversion, a fraction, the hex and binary of an integer, the ISO date

screenshots.caption: 12 usd to try at the ECB's rate; the reverse conversion is the second row
A day count, with the weeks and months on the right
10:00 UTC in Tokyo, the full date there as the second row
What a result can do: copy, paste into the app in front, copy without formatting

features: Inbox: unread first then recent, each row with the sender's avatar (Gravatar, else the initial on a tinted tile), the subject, the snippet, the labels as chips, a paperclip when there is an attachment, the date
Enter opens the message in Gmail at the thread; cmd+Enter marks it read; the pane shows the message as text with the quoted replies folded, the headers and the attachments listed
Search Mail as you type with Gmail's own syntax (from:, subject:, has:attachment, newer_than:7d), the results sectioned by label
Labels: every label, yours and Gmail's; open it in Gmail or search it here
The bar item: the unread count, hidden at zero, refreshed every two minutes and on wake; the popover lists the newest five with Open and Mark as read
Two accounts are two instances, each with its own token command, address, palettes and bar item, told apart by the title and the badge on the tile
Sending is off per account until you turn it on: with it, Compose and Reply as forms, Drafts to send or discard, Archive and Star on a row. A work account stays read and mark-read only
No secret in pal: a command of yours prints the token (gcloud, a helper, a broker), pal keeps it in memory until it expires

manifest.author: pal

store.tagline: Wordle in the panel: a daily puzzle, practice words, stats
features: The board as a view level: letters type into the row, Enter submits, the row flips tile by tile into green, amber and grey; the on-screen keyboard colours as the letters are found
A daily puzzle seeded from the date (`daily` setting): opening on a new day starts it, one word a day, the same on every machine
`N` for a practice word once the day's puzzle is done (or any time with dailies off, as `cmd+n` mid-game)
A word not in the list, or a hard-mode slip, is a red badge over the board; hard mode keeps greens in place and makes ambers count
The result view: played, win %, streak and best, the guess distribution as bars, `C` copies the emoji grid for sharing
Escape leaves at any point; the game and the stats are there when you come back, across restarts
The word lists ship with the extension (public domain sources, see the README); nothing is fetched

screenshots.caption: The daily, three guesses in and two letters typed: the keyboard shows what the guesses found
A word that is not in the list: the badge over the board, the row stays for editing
Solved in four: the praise, the stats and the guess distribution, C copies the grid
